description: This Java class 'ReorderTwo' extends Activity and sets up a UI with a button that, when clicked, starts another activity 'ReorderThree'. It is part of an Android application demonstrating activity reordering.

classes.name: ReorderTwo
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a layout with a button; clicking the button launches the 'ReorderThree' activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets up the UI and button click listener.

methods.name: mClickListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that handles button click to start 'ReorderThree' activity.
